description.value: Kilby Lodge is a guest house situated in Agassiz, BC, near the historic Kilby General Store and the confluence of the Fraser and Harrison rivers. The property sits in the rural Fraser Valley, a region popular with cyclists riding the Lougheed Highway corridor or connecting to Harrison Hot Springs. It holds a dedicated website and direct contact details, suggesting an actively managed accommodation.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fetch failed with an SSL error, so all evidence comes exclusively from OSM tags. OSM confirms the business name, address (76 Kilby Road, Agassiz), phone, email, and website URL, but provides no amenity-level detail. Because no website content is available, all required criteria and optional amenities must be set to null — absence of evidence is not negative evidence.
concerns: Website fetch failed with SSL error (wrong_version_number on kilbylodge.com port 443) — all amenity fields are unverifiable; manual re-check of the website is recommended.
pre_enrichment_exclude flag was set to true due to prefetch_failed_stub, but the business appears real and active based on OSM data.
